question: Which of the following states has the highest child sex ratio in India according to the 5th National Family Health Survey (2019-21)?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Mizoram__.**

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, Mizoram has the highest child sex ratio in India according to the 5th National Family Health Survey (2019-21).**
 
• **Sex ratio at birth for children born in the last five years in India and its states/UTs.**
 
• Child sex ratio 
 
 
• the number of females per thousand males in the age group 0–6 years in a human population.
 
 
 
• The child sex ratio in India decreased between 2001 to 2011.
